title: The pseudo-quantum representation of finite reversible Markov chains
summary: The pseudo-quantum representation re-encodes a finite, irreducible, reversible continuous-time Markov chain with $M$ states as a complex-orthogonal flow on a doubled space of dimension $2M$. After uniformisation, a square-root gauge, a doubling of the state space and a diagonal unitary twist, the chain generates an entire one-parameter group $W_z = e^{zK}$ with $z$ complex, and this single group is the object of the paper.
